stakeholders.name: Daniel Whitaker
stakeholders.division_description: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust governance.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You are responsible for fundamental data activities, enabling data operations in a high-quality, secure, and scalable way. Your typical set of tasks include identifying suitable data sources, verifying data legality, collecting data from various sources, cleaning them, and preparing labeled data. This data engineering process is characterized as extract-transfer-load which involves transferring data into consumable formats for your own role and ML engineers.
stakeholders.priorities: Ensuring high-quality, secure, and scalable data operations and pipelines.
stakeholders.requirements: Calls for diverse data sources and data legality. Requires building robust storage infrastructures and pipelines.

stakeholders.name: Jimmy Everick
stakeholders.division_description: Explores data and trains models to maximize predictive performance. Ensures methodological soundness and iterates on models to meet requirements.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You are mainly responsible for exploring and analyzing the data, training, tuning, and evaluating models to derive insights. Your task is to understand the business problem and its domain, evaluate the feasibility of an ML-enabled solution. At this step, you work with domain experts and business analysts to discuss objectives and key results.
stakeholders.priorities: Maximizing predictive performance of models. Exploring new algorithms and features.
stakeholders.requirements: Calls for reproducibility and methodological soundness during Model and Data related tasks.

stakeholders.name: Emily Brooks
stakeholders.division_description: Manages deployment, integration, and operational stability of ML models. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You play a role in ensuring the seamless deployment, integration, and stability of ML models within production systems. Your responsibilities sometimes overlap with those of ML Engineering. While some studies indicate you are replaced with MLOps engineers for ML projects, a few mention you work within the same team.
stakeholders.priorities: Ensuring seamless deployment, integration, and stability of models and services in production.
stakeholders.requirements: Calls for stability while handling frequent deployments. Needs to construct and test reliable applications.

stakeholders.name: Lilly Simons
stakeholders.division_description: Develops applications and services that integrate ML models for users. Requires stable infrastructure to deliver reliable ML-powered features.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You develop the final applications and services that support ML production. You often collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers in data processing and analysis, and model building. Besides, deployment, packing, releasing, configuring, and monitoring of ML systems are also reported as the role of you.
stakeholders.priorities: Pushes the delivery of reliable ML-powered features that directly improve the user experience.
stakeholders.requirements: Requires stable and accurate ML systems and infrastructure.

stakeholders.name: Mathis Berger
stakeholders.division_description: Handles deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of ML systems. Uses automated CI/CD and feedback loops for iterative improvements.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You are responsible for deployment operations including packaging, releasing, and configuring ML systems  and continuous monitoring of the model's performance. You are facilitating iterative improvements by reporting issues, providing feedback, and ensuring the model remains efficient and reliable in real-world applications.
stakeholders.priorities: CI/CD and working feedback loops. Identifying and reporting issues to facilitate iterative improvements.
stakeholders.requirements: Automated feedback loops and monitoring infrastructure, iterative development using agile development practices.

stakeholders.name: Branson Mcnail
stakeholders.division_description: Architects production ML systems with a focus on scalable, secure design. Prioritizes stability, reproducibility, and cost control across workflows.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You are responsible for designing and building ML systems and services that serve as the backbone of ML operations in production. Your role includes secure design, selecting appropriate technologies and design paradigms, tracking and monitoring models in production, and integrating cloud-based applications and web services.
stakeholders.priorities: Keeping infrastructure stable and reproducible. Controlling costs of compute and storage.
stakeholders.requirements: Flexible and scalable infrastructure that supports modular system architecture and integration with cloud services.

stakeholders.name: Jason Fletcher
stakeholders.division_description: Safeguards ML assets by defining security requirements and practices. Prioritizes data integrity, confidentiality, and robust threat detection.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You ensure the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of ML assets by defining security objectives and requirements at the project's initiation. Some studies refer to you as a dedicated security team or security engineers, while others define you as data and software engineers with security expertise. Your role involves securing the data, the overall ML system, addressing potential attacks during data ingestion and feature engineering, and enforcing secure coding practices.
stakeholders.priorities: Guaranteeing the integrity, confidentiality, and security of all ML assets.
stakeholders.requirements: Secure development environments with strict access control, auditing, and vulnerability scanning. Needs tools for threat detection, encryption management, and secure data handling across the ML pipeline.

stakeholders.name: David Kimmel
stakeholders.division_description: Oversees data governance, privacy compliance, and accountability. Ensures ML initiatives meet legal standards and reduce reputational risks.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You focus on data governance and privacy.
stakeholders.priorities: Transparency, accountability, and fairness in model development. Meeting internal and external compliance standards.
stakeholders.requirements: Needs systems and regulatory frameworks that support compliance with data protection regulations and enforce governance policies. The environment must enable auditing, documentation, and traceability of datasets and models.

stakeholders.name: Olivia Grant
stakeholders.division_description: Conducts rigorous testing to guarantee high product quality. Requires environments that support automated testing and validation.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You are responsible for testing the software application and services to ensure product quality.
stakeholders.priorities: Guaranteeing high product quality through rigorous testing of applications.
stakeholders.requirements: Development workflow must allow for testing and validation. Needs environments that support automated tests for ML pipelines, models, and services.

stakeholders.name: Francis Dumont
stakeholders.division_description: Manages data quality and documentation to align with strategy. Focuses on maximizing business impact and ROI of ML features.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You specifically focus on data quality management.
stakeholders.priorities: Aligning ML initiatives with organizational strategy. Evaluating return on investment and business impact.
stakeholders.requirements: Data management that ensures data quality, consistency and documentation and includes clear ownership and versioning of data assets.

stakeholders.name: Marcus Turner
stakeholders.division_description: Uses deep domain knowledge to guide development and validate results. Ensures ML solutions effectively fulfill specific business goals.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You possess deep knowledge of the problem domain, such as clinical neurologists for an ML-enabled psychological monitoring system or urban planners for a smart city system. You are described as an “irreplaceable actor within ML projects” due to your crucial role in domain discovery, engineering domain specific requirements, and fulfilling business goals. Moreover, you contribute to data collection, cleaning, labeling, hypothesis development, model evaluation, and result interpretation.
stakeholders.priorities: Applying deep domain knowledge to ensure models fulfill specific business goals.
stakeholders.requirements: The environment should make it easy to incorporate domain knowledge into the ML development process.

stakeholders.name: Theresa Meyer
stakeholders.division_description: Defines business problems, objectives, and KPIs for ML initiatives. Ensures ML solutions align with overarching business goals.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You define the problem, set clear objectives, and assess whether an ML-enabled system can provide a solution to the problem at hand. MLOps team collaborates with you to gain a better understanding of the problem and convert it to a successful ML solution that aligns with the business goals. You also define business requirements, key performance indicators (KPIs), and model quality metrics, leveraging query processing on structured datasets to analyze business problems.
stakeholders.priorities: Aligning ML solutions with clear objectives, KPIs, and business goals.
stakeholders.requirements: Clear documentation, KPIs and reporting capabilities to evaluate whether ML solutions meet business objectives.

stakeholders.name: Willis Slif
stakeholders.division_description: Drives decision-making and supervises development and operations. Focuses on operational capability and monitoring system costs.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You are often associated with organization level decision making, supervision of other roles in development and operations, and evaluating the production of ML systems from an operational and regulatory perspective.
stakeholders.priorities: Making organization-level decisions and enhancing overall operational capability.
stakeholders.requirements: Monitoring tools that provide clear insights into system performance, costs, and business impact. Transparent documentation and progress tracking to support oversight of development and operational activities.

stakeholders.name: Hannah Glaser
stakeholders.division_description: Defines and optimizes product features for performance and usability. Uses data-driven insights to manage roadmaps and prioritize features.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You are associated with defining and optimizing product features to enhance performance and usability. For example, you identify feature set candidates based on specific performance issues and apply feature engineering techniques alongside to improve model outcomes. You make data-driven decisions by reviewing relevant collected and visualized information.
stakeholders.priorities: Defining products by defining and optimizing product features.
stakeholders.requirements: Development monitoring and progress tracking using product roadmaps and issue management systems.

stakeholders.name: Simone Phillips
stakeholders.division_description: Builds automated ML pipelines and maintains operational stability. Focuses on CI/CD and seamless cross-role collaboration.
stakeholders.responsibilities: You are responsible for building automated pipelines, maintaining operational stability of the entire ML system, and facilitating collaboration across roles. While data science and research roles design and implement the pipelines for data collection, analysis, model development, and deployment, you focus on building, optimizing, and integrating these pipelines, including services like cloud and containers. You manage dependencies, versioning, tracking mechanisms, and platform governance.
stakeholders.priorities: Building automated pipelines and maintaining full system operational stability.
stakeholders.requirements: Automated pipelines, version control, and continuous integration and deployment. Orchestration of services across cloud and container platforms.

stakeholders.name: Michigal Sellner
stakeholders.division_description: Specializes in optimizing, deploying, and monitoring ML models. Relies on infrastructure for versioning and performance tracking.
stakeholders.responsibilities: Your role's responsibilites partly overlap with those of data scientists. Many studies distinguish your role with your primary tasks being model optimization, deployment, and monitoring. Whereas, experimenting with datasets and models, and optimizing the model and its parameters are tasks shared with data science and research.
stakeholders.priorities: Optimizing, deploying, and monitoring high-performing ML models.
stakeholders.requirements: Infrastructure and services that supports efficient model training, experimentation, and deployment including model versioning tools, and performance monitoring systems.

stakeholders.responsibilities: You are mainly responsible for exploring and analyzing the data, training, tuning, and evaluating models to derive insights. Your task is to understand the business problem and its domain, evaluate the feasibility of an ML-enabled solution. At this step, you work with domain experts and business analysts to discuss objectives and key results.
stakeholders.priorities: Maximizing predictive performance of models. Exploring new algorithms and features.
stakeholders.requirements: Calls for reproducibility and methodological soundness during Model and Data related tasks.

stakeholders.responsibilities: You are often associated with organization level decision making, supervision of other roles in development and operations, and evaluating the production of ML systems from an operational and regulatory perspective.
stakeholders.priorities: Making organization-level decisions and enhancing overall operational capability.
stakeholders.requirements: Monitoring tools that provide clear insights into system performance, costs, and business impact. Transparent documentation and progress tracking to support oversight of development and operational activities.

stakeholders.name: Diyar Tetik
stakeholders.division_description: Responsible for fetching coffee and trying not to break production. Still figuring out what MLOps actually stands for.
stakeholders.responsibilities: Your main responsibilities include shadowing senior developers, staring blankly at the architecture diagrams, and occasionally asking 'Are we sure we shouldn't just use a massive spreadsheet?'. You are the first line of defense in ordering lunch and an absolute expert in resetting your own password. Please do not touch the main branch.
stakeholders.priorities: Surviving the probation period. Ensuring the coffee machine is always filled with beans.
stakeholders.requirements: Clear instructions, frequent supervision, and a comfortable chair is highly appreciated.
